published_baseline: Founder-approved Geomacro Commercial V1 website with concise buyer-first desktop and mobile navigation; live Intelligence, separate Risk Indices, Critical Minerals and Rare Earth Risk, Ask Geomacro, institutional workflows, governed API and agent access, dedicated Pricing, and Risk Gate boundaries remain clearly separated from technical-proof surfaces. Production public serving remains B2-authoritative with Supabase in ingestion/recovery standby only. The Intelligence workspace now restores data parity after the Supabase-to-B2 cutover: fresh live observations remain clearly labelled live observed and unscored, while recent verified scored B2 records remain visible as latest verified context instead of being hidden whenever current unscored observations exist. Current-only top-risk semantics remain strict; older verified scored rows are exposed separately as verified risk context and are never relabelled as current. No timestamp rewriting, synthetic scores, or Supabase customer-serving fallback is introduced. Pricing retains its dedicated /pricing route, Ask Geomacro retains the explicit /api/public-ask boundary, and Intelligence/Risk Indices retain explicit public API boundaries. Homepage remains pricing-free; Free Explorer and the 0.05 USDC x402 first-20,000 successful paid-delivery offer remain on dedicated Pricing/API surfaces. Customer Care and contact@geomacro.live remain the human support escalation path. x402 production activation remains separately fail-closed and controlled.
policy: Public website presentation is frozen. Intentional website changes require explicit founder approval and a dedicated baseline update.
